Some senators were genuine in their desire to make improvements, while others were entirely corrupt and sought only personal gain. Senators were often served by various [[aide]]s, whose careers were closely tied to the senator they served, unless they were able to replace them.''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' Many senators of the [[Galactic Republic]] supported and cheered [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Proclamation of the New Order|proclamation]] that turned the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars]].{{Film|III}} The senators then became members of the [[Imperial Senate]]. Fourteen [[Standard year|years]] into the Imperial Senate's existence, the power of the senators had grown weaker as the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor's]] planetary [[governor]]s and [[Moff]]s exercised more responsibility over their planets and [[Star system|systems]].''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' A few years later, the Imperial Senate was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate|disbanded]] by the Emperor. Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] achieved their goal and restored the Republic in the form of the [[New Republic]]. As one of its first acts in the long process of bringing back [[democracy]] to the [[galaxy]], the Republic restored the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]]. ==Description== {{Quote|We serve the galaxy. We act as the voice of the people.|Riyo Chuchi|{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}}}} In the [[Galactic Republic]], the ways in which a senator was brought into the [[Galactic Senate]] varied depending on the local culture. Some senators were elected via a popular vote from their local constituents. However, many others were brought into the Senate via the appointment of planetary leaders, secured the position through birthright inheritance, and any other number of non-electoral means.''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'' A senator's formalwear reflected the culture of their [[homeworld]] but could also command respect when they negotiated deals. Many senators proudly wore the traditional attire of their people, although some used their status and the significant budget of their office to purchase lavish [[clothing]]. They instead wore the finest imported fabrics in elaborate creations designed by the most famous fashion designers on Coruscant. Prudent senatorial aides followed the lead of their senator in the attire they chose for official duties, although others focused instead on creating an intimidating presence.''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' ==History== ===Decay of the Galactic Republic=== {{Quote|There is no civility, only politics. The Republic is not what it once was. The Senate is full of greedy, squabbling delegates. There is no interest in the common good.|Sheev Palpatine|}} [[File:PadmeROTS1.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Senators like Padmé Amidala and Bail Organa served in the Senate during the late Republic Era.]] During the last [[Standard decade|decades]] of the Galactic Republic, senators represented the Republic's various member [[Planet|worlds]], [[sector]]s and commerce guilds, including the [[Trade Federation]], at the Galactic Senate on [[Coruscant]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo]], [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] served as the senator for [[Naboo]] and overall [[Chommell sector]]''[[Queen's Peril]]'' while [[Lott Dod]] represented the Federation. Their functions including representing their [[homeworld]]s, adjudicating on galactic disputes, and debating and voting on legislation and motions. However, Senate proceedings had grown increasingly gridlocked over the Republic's life time. One major issue came with the corporate senators, who actively took advantage of the system for corporate profit{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} or to stall motions that threatened their company's interests and bottom-line.''[[Queen's Shadow]]'' [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] held a distaste for senators who represented companies instead of planet, but such an opinion had become outdated and something he needed to keep hidden. Despite the meddling of such senators, most beings in the galaxy were of the opinion that senators from employers deserved a place in the Senate. By the [[time]] of the [[Separatist Crisis]], the Senate had at least two thousand senators.''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]'' Several [[Loyalist]] senators, including the Naboo senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], the [[Alderaanian]] senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], and the [[Ryloth]] senator [[Orn Free Taa]] formed the [[Loyalist Committee]] to advise [[Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine.{{Film|II}} During the time of the Galactic Republic, the position had no term limit. After the [[Raxus Address|creation]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], many important senators—such as [[Toonbuck Toora]] and [[Rogwa Wodrata]]—elected to support the Republic's new rival.{{GermanFanCite|84|Database}} By the [[Clone Wars]] between the Republic and Confederacy, the Confederacy had established a rival [[Separatist Senate]] on the planet [[Raxus Secundus]]. Some prominent Separatist senators included the Onderonian [[Mina Bonteri]] and her son [[Lux Bonteri]], [[Prime Minister]] [[Bec Lawise]], and [[Voe Atell]]. Towards the end of the conflict, several concerned Republic senators including Amidala, Organa, and [[Mon Mothma]] formed the [[Delegation of 2,000]] to criticize Palpatine's conduct of the war and to petition him to return his emergency powers to the Galactic Senate.{{Databank|meena-tills|Meena Tills}} ===Galactic Empire=== {{Quote|I am a member of the Imperial Senate on a diplomatic mission to Alderaan—''"
"''You are a part of the Rebel Alliance and a traitor. Take her away!|Leia Organa and Darth Vader|}} Following the [[Proclamation of the New Order]], the Galactic Senate was revamped as the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. While many senators welcomed the establishment of the Empire as an end to the carnage and destruction of the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars, others like Amidala and Organa were unhappy with the [[New Order]]. After Palpatine crowned himself as [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], the Imperial Senate's powers were progressively curtailed. By the fourteenth [[Standard year|year]] of the [[Imperial Era|Age of the Empire]], Imperial senators wielded less power than planetary [[governor]]s. [[File:PrincessLeia1_MileHighComics_TextlessVariant.png|thumb|right|300x330px|Senator Leia Organa represented Alderaan in the Imperial Senate, and was in league with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.]] The Emperor preserved the Senate in order to convince its member worlds that they still had a part to play in the new government. In secret, the Emperor planned to [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate|abolish]] the Senate once the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] had been completed so that he could rule the Empire through terror.[[Darth Vader (2015) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 1]] Some senators like the [[Thrad]] senator [[Nadea Tural]] continued attending Senate sessions since she believed that the Empire passed legislation which had been voted into law. However, the Emperor often did not implement legislation introduced by the Senate. Some other notable senators included Bail Organa's adopted daughter [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], and the "Senator-in-exile" [[Gall Trayvis]].{{Rebels|Vision of Hope}} Following the [[Battle of Scarif|theft]] of the [[Death Star plans]], [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] [[Secret mission to Tatooine|arrested]] [[Princess]] Leia for aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. Emperor Palpatine promptly dissolved the Imperial Senate. In addition, Tural and several other dissident senators were [[Prison|imprisoned]] at the [[Arrth-Eno Prison Complex]] on Coruscant. The Alliance attempted to rescue the imprisoned senators but the Emperor hatched a [[Arrth-Eno Mission|successful plot]] to [[Death|kill]] the senators and the Rebel [[Spy|spies]]. Official Imperial [[propaganda]] claimed that the rebels had bombed the prison in order to deny these senators a trial.[[Star Wars Annual (2015) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (2015) 1]] ===New Republic=== {{Quote|War is terrible. And an army isn't enough to fix problems. We need a solution for what happens after they do their job, and that's why the Senate is beginning again…|[[Olia Choko]]|}} Following the [[Battle of Endor]], the [[New Republic]], the successor government established by the Alliance to Restore the Republic, re-established the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] on [[Chandrila]]. Their duties included representing their homeworlds, debating and voting on legislation and motions, and investigating intrasystem disputes and criminal factions that threatened the New Republic. New Republic senatorial protocol also differentiated senators into two main categories: [[Senior Senator|senior senator]] and [[junior senator]].[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] [[File:LeiaMTFBWY.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Organa resumed her political career in the New Republic Senate, and was the Populists' choice for the post of First Senator.]] About twenty four years after the events on [[Endor]], two major senatorial factions had emerged in the Galactic Senate: the [[Centrists]], who desired a stronger galactic government and [[New Republic Defense Force|military]]; and the [[Populists]], who wanted to preserve considerable autonomy for member worlds. The rivalry and philosophical differences between the two factions created deadlock in the Senate, which led to much inaction on the part of the New Republic. In response to this deadlock, the Centrists proposed the creation of a new office called [[First Senator]], which would wield considerable power over the economy and military. Some prominent New Republic senators included Leia Organa, the [[Gatalenta]] senator [[Tai-Lin Garr]], the [[Arkanis]] senator [[Lady]] [[Carise Sindian]], and the [[Riosa]]n senator [[Ransolm Casterfo]]. Prior to the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]], several New Republic senators including Lady Carise and [[Erudo Ro-Kiintor]] were secretly colluding with the [[First Order]], a remnant of the Old Empire.''[[Before the Awakening]]'' In [[29 ABY]],According to ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', the Centrists seceded from the New Republic and joined the First Order five [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the Hosnian Cataclysm to [[34 ABY]], the Centrists seceded in [[29 ABY]]. a number of Centrist systems became disenfranchised with the failures of the New Republic and [[First Order secession|seceded]],''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' publicly forming the political core of the First Order.''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' The New Republic, along with its Senate, fell{{Film|VII}} in [[34 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' when the First Order fired [[Starkiller Base]]; the superweapon [[Hosnian Cataclysm|wiped out]] the [[Hosnian system]], leaving any surviving senators to dissolve the remnants of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] to protect their homeworlds.''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' One surviving senator was [[Hamato Xiono]], who was offworld with his [[Xiono family|family]] when [[Hosnian Prime]] was destroyed.{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} ==Galactic Republic, later Imperial Senators== {|{{Prettytable}} !
